name: Sarjis Alam
contribution: A nationally visible coordinator, he was among the student leaders taken into DB custody in July 2024 and became one of the most quoted public voices of the movement.
context: Nationwide anti-discrimination protests; detention and media-facing phase in July 2024.
impact: He helped sustain public messaging during the movement’s most volatile period.
highlight: One of the movement’s most visible on-camera coordinators.
seoDescription: Sarjis Alam was a visible coordinator of Students Against Discrimination, helping carry the quota reform movement into the wider July uprising and post-uprising youth politics.
shortAnswer: A visible Students Against Discrimination coordinator who helped carry the quota reform movement into the wider July uprising.

faq.question: How is Sarjis Alam connected to the 2024 Anti-Discrimination Movement?
faq.answer: Sarjis Alam is connected to the 2024 movement as Coordinator and spokesperson. A nationally visible coordinator, he was among the student leaders taken into DB custody in July 2024 and became one of the most quoted public voices of the movement.
